current_article.title: Join Pokémon GO Community Meetups for Pokémon GO Fest 2024: Global!
current_article.text:
Updates
Join Pokémon GO Community Meetups for Pokémon GO Fest 2024: Global!
Trainers,
On Saturday, July 13 and Sunday, July 14, 2024, millions of Trainers from around the world will come together to embark on exclusive adventures—and you can participate wherever you are! Get your Pokémon GO Fest 2024: Global ticket and join the fun catching special Pokémon and unlocking event bonuses and rewards!
GO Fest 2024: Global is the best event of the year to discover new adventures in Pokémon GO! It’s also a great opportunity to explore new places and connect with Pokémon GO communities at meetups. Let’s get outside, make new friends, and reunite with old ones!
Find your local meetup taking place on July 13 – 14 by checking the Community map ! You can also find a list of community-run events happening near you below!

Community Leader Activations

For the latest on in-game events and feature updates, be sure to check this help center article
Please be aware of your surroundings and follow guidelines from local health authorities when playing Pokémon GO. Upcoming events are subject to change. Be sure to follow us on social media, opt in to receiving push notifications, and subscribe to our emails to stay updated.
—The Pokémon GO team
